Market today: Tech is getting hammered, especially the leveraged names. AI hype is cooling, and Apple's warning is a big red flag for the sector.

Your holdings: SMCI (-27.85%), MU (-40.49%), SOXL (-67.46%), and SPAL (-43.22%) are all leveraged ETFs deep in the red. METU (-18.84%) and PLTU (-15.95%) are also bleeding. Your QQQ (-4.08%) and SMH (-18.56%) are also under pressure. CRWD (39.35%) is your only real winner.

Watch: Apple's AI warning and the broader tech sell-off. Keep an eye on your leveraged positions.

Bottom line: Your concentrated, leveraged tech book is taking a beating. Focus on damage control and risk management.
plays: Trim leveraged ETFs like SOXL, SPAL, MU, METU, PLTU if they show further weakness.
Consider trimming QQQ and SMH if they break key support levels.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
